name: Mpox
value: 219 EU/EEA clade I cases in Oct (ECDC)
summary: Clade I mpox keeps spreading outside Africa: 15 EU/EEA countries reported cases in October; no new emergency declared
state: ECDC's 13 Nov update says 15 EU/EEA countries reported 219 clade I mpox cases in October, Germany the most, and rates risk low for the general population (ECDC). UKHSA's overview of 12 Nov counts 298 confirmed UK clade Ib cases to 31 Oct (UKHSA). Searches on 22 Nov found no new emergency of international concern, so continued clade I spread outside Africa keeps Watch.
for_you: Risk to the general public is low. UKHSA and the NHS offer mpox vaccination to eligible groups; travellers to affected countries can check UKHSA's list of clade I affected countries.
rubric_hit: Clade I spreading outside Africa (15 EU/EEA countries in Oct) = Watch

sources.title: UKHSA — Mpox outbreak: epidemiological overview, 12 November 2026

why: Clade I mpox is more severe and has spread beyond Central Africa.
drivers: Case growth, vaccine access, travel-linked spread.
